GitHub installation access tokens expire after one hour. Narrow each mint with
repositories; expires_at is returned. Re-mint with an App JWT, not a refresh token.
GH_TOKEN precedes GITHUB_TOKEN and stored gh credentials on github.com.
Git uses installation tokens as HTTPS passwords. GH_TOKEN alone does not configure Git.
An empty credential.helper resets the helper list; subsequent helpers replace ambient helpers.
RS256 App JWTs use iat 60 seconds in the past and exp at most ten minutes in the future.
An empty http.extraHeader resets headers. http.followRedirects=false rejects redirects.
URL-specific HTTP settings use the longest matching path, so reset each validated URL.
